explanations: The appendix index and the ten lesson lists agree entry for entry on 296 numbered words (every index locator is confirmed below). The editor's note says 290, 6 fewer. 9 of the 296 re-teach a word an earlier volume already taught (listed below, one lexicon item each) and one (心情, L2 and L8) repeats inside the book; no simple rule on those reproduces 290, so the book's own index and lesson lists (296) are taken as authoritative and the 290 is reported as the editor's figure.

Grammar: the book numbers 39 sections; its lesson-1 section 以前 / 以後 teaches two patterns, cites a different earlier volume for each, and is listed here as two points, giving the stated 40. 以後 and 從…到… are re-teaches of points from books 1 and 2 and keep their original items.
